title: Resize images and keep objects editable
summary: Set image dimensions in pixels or percent, retain editable objects, and restore the previous size with Undo.

Added: Resize Image opens from the Image menu or the dimensions strip. Pixels and Percent support linked aspect ratio or independent width and height, with validation before Apply.
Original pixels remain available for Revert to Original. Resize, Undo/Redo and project persistence include dimensions and editable object geometry.
Improved: Source resampling handles transparency without bleeding hidden RGB into visible edges. Later resizes use the retained original image.
Cancel and nested-popup Escape preserve the document. Invalid sizes and unchanged dimensions do not consume history.
Verified: Native 640 × 400 to 320 × 200 resize, Undo/Redo, saved dimensions and all seven editable objects. Native clipboard matches all 64000 resized pixels.
Revert restores all 256000 original pixels and Undo recovers the resized objects. Shared tests cover alpha edges, source retention, invalid input and save/reopen.

limitations: Print units, DPI metadata, custom resampling choices, crop and Resize Canvas remain planned. The installed reference Resize dialog has not been inspected.
Extreme scales may exceed supported text, stroke or padding limits and are rejected. Unlocked text and stroke sizes use the smaller axis scale.
Resized projects require this version or later. Editable projects retain original pixels. Native Export file-picker inspection remains blocked.
